column3: This is VLA Forge, with a new guide. The little robot greets you on the landing page and flies to each section to point things out.
In the app, I type one task for an SO-101 and send it.
Every step is a message between Fetch.ai uAgents. Fetch.ai is the multi-agent orchestration, and Llama powers the reasoning agents: task, critic and optimizer.
Back on the canvas, the robot flies to the stage being worked on and points at it with its gripper.
Press T and the Thinking panel shows each agent's reasoning as it happens. I ask the dock what it is doing, and it answers from the live run.
The wait is sped up four times, and the badge shows it. When training starts, the robot moves to the loss chart.
That is the new forge: a guide that roams, a Thinking panel, and agents you can watch, all in simulation.
